2014_spells.kinetic-jaunt.description: You magically empower your movement with dance-like steps and spinning leaps. Until the spell ends, you don't provoke opportunity attacks, and each foot of movement you make while you're not incapacitated costs 1 extra foot of movement instead of 1 foot. If you make a melee attack against a creature, you can double the damage of the attack as long as you hit the target.
2014_spells.kinetic-jaunt.effectSummary: Make a target incapacitated until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.kinetic-jaunt.fullDescriptio: Using 1 bonus action, you magically empower your movement with dance-like steps and spinning leaps. Until the spell ends, you don't provoke opportunity attacks, and each foot of movement you make while you're not incapacitated costs 1 extra foot of movement instead of 1 foot; If you make a melee attack against a creature, you can double the damage of the attack as long as you hit the target. Until the spell ends, you don't provoke opportunity attacks, and each foot of movement you make while you're not incapacitated costs 1 extra foot of movement instead of 1 foot; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
